'''Olianna''' was a female [[A'Mar]], the [[Human/Legends|Human]] settlers of [[Lamus]]. When she was six [[Standard year/Legends|years]] old, she was the only one of her generation eligible to participate in [[the Vigil]] as she had not yet drunk the [[Water/Legends|waters]] from the [[Wellspring (Lamus)|Wellspring]].
